topics.title: Write a paragraph about a problem you faced with a friend.
topics.sample_essay: One day, I had a problem with my best friend Ahmed. He borrowed my book and did not return it. I felt angry because I needed it for my homework. I talked to him and he said he forgot it at home. I told him that he should return it the next day. He did, and we solved the problem. Now we always remind each other about things we borrow.

topics.title: Write a paragraph about your best friend.
topics.sample_essay: My best friend is Khaled. He is tall and has brown hair. He is kind and helpful. He always helps me with my homework. We play football together after school. I like him because he is honest and loyal. We have been friends for five years. I am happy to have him as my best friend.
